migration_vocabulary_not_compatibility.purpose: Keep future command/reply docs familiar for ArkApi/AseApi modders without claiming direct compatibility or copying parsers, ordering, return semantics, offsets, layouts, vtables, or implementation.
registration_semantics: future command registration must be owner-token scoped
future command names must be normalized by an Obelisk-owned contract before duplicate detection
duplicate normalized command names must have deterministic owner-token scoped conflict handling
unsupported or unknown source_kind fails closed
permission denial or unknown result never dispatches a command
missing permission policy provenance fails closed
reply request is copied request data only and never implies response delivery until command_chat_response_path is separately promoted
non_compatibility_claims: no ArkApi or AseApi dispatch ordering compatibility
no ArkApi or AseApi return semantics compatibility
no copied command parser, control flow, offsets, layouts, vtables, native-call wrappers, or ABI semantics

forbidden_public_contract: command parser copied from ArkApi or AseApi
public CallProcessEvent command or reply path
principal or permission claims from command text
principal or permission claims from operator config

required_before_public_header.decision_required: Promote obelisk.player_identity.v1 before any public command routing, command registration, or reply targeting contract is public.
Promote query-only fail-closed permissions/admin before commands can authorize execution or admin-like behavior.
Promote obelisk.command_chat_response_path.v1 before commands/replies can claim reply, send-chat, broadcast, notice, or directed response behavior.
required_behavior: commands/replies remains blocked while command_chat_response_path is unpromoted or unresolved
passive ChatMessageEvent parsing does not authorize replies
legacy CallProcessEvent debug access does not authorize responses
no response path is public through commands/replies until the response path is separately promoted

required_before_public_header.decision_required: Define an append-only copied POD command payload before any command callback, registration, or dispatch ABI is public.
required_properties: no raw UE pointers or raw params
no public UFunction or vtable details

required_before_public_header.decision_required: Do not add command/reply public header symbols until every commands/replies blocker is resolved.
required_behavior: public_header_symbols_now remains empty
no commands/replies capability bit is advertised
no public register/unregister command ABI exists
no public reply or send-chat ABI exists
no public command_chat_response_path ABI is exposed through commands/replies
CallProcessEvent is not a public command or reply mechanism

required_before_public_header.decision_required: Define identity, generation, scope, and permission provenance before any command can execute.
required_behavior: principal_handle, principal_generation, and principal_scope_flags must appear together in any future command payload that consumes player identity
principal_handle alone never authorizes command dispatch
missing principal fails closed
missing principal_handle fails closed
missing principal_generation fails closed
missing principal_scope_flags fails closed
stale principal fails closed
unsupported principal_scope_flags fails closed
missing permission policy provenance fails closed
permission denial or unknown result never dispatches a command
command text remains copied request data only and cannot establish identity, permission authority, or policy provenance
operator config remains policy input only and cannot establish command identity, principal identity, permission authority, or policy provenance
command callbacks cannot self-attest permission authority
admin-like commands require a separately promoted admin authority contract

required_before_public_header.decision_required: Define owner-scoped command registration, unregister, init-failure cleanup, unload cleanup, and in-flight dispatch drain behavior.
required_behavior: command registrations are owner-token scoped
duplicate command names have deterministic owner-scoped conflict handling
plugin init failure removes all command registrations before dlclose
plugin unload unregisters commands and waits for in-flight callbacks or fails closed without dlclose
self-unregister from a command callback is safe
command callbacks cannot outlive copied payload storage
server shutdown does not call into unmapped plugin code

required_before_public_header.decision_required: Design Obelisk command parsing from copied ChatMessageEvent text and promoted Obelisk contracts; do not copy ArkApi/AseApi parser behavior or implementation.
required_behavior: no ArkApi or AseApi command parser code is copied
no ArkApi or AseApi constants, schemas, control flow, return semantics, offsets, vtables, or native-call wrappers are copied
plugin-local parser scaffolds remain local helpers and do not become a public SDK router
public grammar, prefix, quoting, escaping, dispatch ordering, and return behavior require an Obelisk-owned contract
compatibility naming can inform demand only and cannot substitute for promotion evidence

required_before_public_header.decision_required: Define abuse controls and moderation boundaries before commands/replies are public.
required_behavior: command dispatch attempts are rate-limited per plugin owner token and source scope
malformed UTF-8, oversize commands, and unsupported source kinds fail closed
audit records are sanitized and do not expose raw UE internals, platform IDs, raw player names, or secret policy contents
operator controls can disable command dispatch without disabling passive chat intake
moderation, ban, kick, mute, broadcast, scheduled notice, and admin mutation APIs remain separate promotions

required_before_public_header.decision_required: Commands/replies may not imply response delivery, send-chat, replies, moderation, persistence, or admin mutation.

required_evidence: second-source or independently reviewed command source evidence

required_before_public_header.decision_required: Keep commands/replies as a v1 completion blocker until it is promoted or explicitly named post-v1/excluded in a reviewed v1 release statement.
required_behavior: commands/replies is a blocked v1 completion surface now
commands/replies is not sufficient for a complete v1 SDK claim now
public_contract stays empty while status is blocked or unresolved
v1_completion_required must not change because of this planning contract alone

a future exclusion must state that no public command SDK/router, console command API, RCON command API, admin command API, player command API, chat replies, send-chat, broadcast/notices API, or moderation API is included in v1
